messages:
Irene: hey team — I'm at SFO and my flight just got delayed for 6+ hrs. I'm primary for tonight (EU midnight window). I can't reliably take pages, sorry. Can someone cover primary or shadow until I can get a confirmed ETA? I'm still reachable but wifi is flaky. :airplane:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: Pager alert for prod-embeddings (sev2) triggered 2m ago. Pager status: active. Assigned: Irene (primary). Escalation policy: 10m -> secondary. Link: https://redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-0421

Sam: I can take primary for the next 4 hrs — I'm online and near reliable infra. @Irene can you demote yourself in the schedule UI or should I ping ops to swap? :thumbsup:

Irene: @Sam you're a lifesaver. I can't reach the schedule page from the airport wifi. If you can take primary now, please call it out here and I'll mark myself on-call-sick once I get a stable connection.

Alex: I can shadow for the EU window too, but I'm on-call for a deploy window at 22:00 UTC. If heavy paging continues after that, you'll need to reassign.

Sam: taking primary now. I'm setting my PD status to acknowledge and will follow runbook. Anyone seeing customer impact (errors/latency)?

Jess: we've got increased 5xx for embeddings ingestion for AcmeCo and HelenaAnalytics in EU region. Logs show KV cache misses and worker OOMs on worker-embed-03. Short snippet from logs: 
```
2026-04-21T21:15:02Z ERROR worker-embed-03 oom while allocating 512MB
2026-04-21T21:15:03Z WARN prefix-cache miss for user:acmeco-123
```

Sam: thanks. Runbook step 1: restart worker-embed-03 gracefully, step 2: flush prefix cache for affected users, step 3: if OOM persists, scale up dedicated pool or fallback to quantized model. I'll run steps 1-2 now. Runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/embeddings-oom

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: rolling restart of embed-worker pool scheduled at 22:00 UTC as part of hotfix. Impact window: 2-5 minutes per pod.

Alex: note — my deploy at 22:00 is the same pool. Sam, if you need me to cancel my deploy because I'm shadowing, say now. I can reschedule if the incident is still hot.

Sam: do the restart now for worker-embed-03 -> status: restart triggered, monitoring logs. 

Irene: FYI — AcmeCo is on-call too and they DM'd us about delayed ingestion. I've posted the incident link to their escalation channel.

oncall-bot: ACTION: Escalation timer started. If primary (Sam) does not acknowledge within 10m, secondary (Alex) will be paged.

Sam: restart successful, mem usage back to baseline on worker-embed-03. Flushed prefix cache for acmeco-123 and helena-004. Monitoring shows error rate dropping from 4.2% -> 0.7% over 3 mins.

Jess: confirmed decreased 5xx and queue latency normalized. Looks like a transient OOM under high concurrency. Recommend keeping the pool scaled +1 until midnight UTC.

Alex: I can hold shadow until 22:00 and then take over if needed. If we hit another OOM after my deploy, call me and I'll re-step into shadow.

Sam: I'll bump autoscale min by +1 for the pool and set a temporary alert silence to avoid noise from the planned rolling restart at 22:00. Commands I ran: 
```bash
rwctl pool scale embed-dedicated --min 3
rwctl cache flush --user acmeco-123,helena-004
```

Irene: thanks everyone. I'll update the schedule once I land. If anything degrades after 22:00, @Alex please be ready to engage. Appreciate the fast handoff. :raised_hands: 

Sam: marking incident as mitigated for now. Keeping PD acknowledged. Will update slack if it resurfaces.

Alex: noted. Safe travels @Irene.

Jess: closing monitoring loop — will keep an eye for 30m then downgrade the alert if stable.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: incident INC-2026-0421 status -> mitigated. Duration: ~18m. Primary: Sam (ack). Secondary standby: Alex. Logs + actions: https://redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-0421/actions
